hypothesis: Execution errors on Sep 1–2 turned applicants into rejections
evidence: 407 TECHNICAL_ERROR rejections on two days in both countries. Usability NOT_EXECUTED; document checks and face match skipped; liveness passed in all 407; screening passed in 251.
alternatives: A vendor incident; an ARQ integration or configuration fault (upload, file format, credentials); a network problem between ARQ and the vendor.
missing: ARQ request logs, raw vendor responses, vendor incident report, whether these people retried or were later approved.
next: Pull logs and raw responses for both days; ask the vendor for an incident report; check later activity of the affected users.
decision: Whether the fault is ours or the vendor's (fix, SLA claim, or both). The hold-and-retry rule is useful in both cases.

hypothesis: Liveness quality failures on Sep 1 and Sep 6 were caused by a vendor fault
evidence: 174 BAD_QUALITY / FACE_NOT_FULLY_VISIBLE on two days, both countries, codes rare otherwise; a third-party copy of the vendor status page reports liveness incidents on these dates.
alternatives: An ARQ app release or capture change on those days; an SDK version change.
missing: App and SDK version per transaction; intraday timestamps; vendor confirmation that ARQ's region was affected.
next: Compare with the release log; ask the vendor for the affected-transaction list.
decision: Whether to escalate commercially, and whether a retake policy for these codes is worth a test.

hypothesis: The Aug 24 Argentina burst was coordinated fraud
evidence: Argentine volume 660 vs a typical 318; 376 manipulation signals; 373 passed liveness and 373 passed face match.
alternatives: A wave of false positives from the vendor model at the time of a marketing push; a campaign that attracted low-quality applicants; duplicate submissions.
missing: Adjudication of a sample, device and IP data, acquisition channel, cross-transaction links.
next: Review a random sample of flagged cases; check acquisition channel for the day; ask the vendor about repeated faces or backgrounds.
decision: Whether to add pre-vendor velocity and device controls, and how to report attack traffic separately.

hypothesis: The Sep 14–19 Mexico INE flags reflect a vendor rule or model change
evidence: 111 manipulation signals on INE cards with no volume surge (2826 vs 2994 typical); 111 passed liveness.
alternatives: A quieter fraud campaign; a new INE card version the model mis-scores.
missing: Vendor release notes for that week; adjudication of a sample; registry validation of the credentials.
next: Sample review with the vendor; registry check on a sample if available.
decision: Whether INE flags should route to review instead of auto-decline.

hypothesis: Mexico's higher 'no document type' share comes from document choice or capture, not one defect
evidence: No document type returned for 11.3% of Mexican decisions in the prior period and 14.2% in the recent one. Argentina has almost none. 1,034 recent Mexican rejections have no reason code.
alternatives: Documents outside the accepted list; poor captures the vendor cannot classify; issuer-country mismatch; document configuration; vendor gaps for some INE versions.
missing: Image sample with the vendor, the document type the user selected, the accepted-document configuration, app version.
next: Review 100 recent cases with the vendor; compare configuration history; split by app version once logged.
decision: Choose between a document picker, a configuration change or a vendor escalation.

hypothesis: Face-match failures are a large problem from before the drop, partly from old ID photos
evidence: Face match was 2.77% of prior-period decisions and 2.41% of recent ones: it improved, so it did not cause the drop. Mexican national ID cards fail face match more often than INE cards.
alternatives: Impostors; poor light on the selfie; card type.
missing: Adjudication of a sample; document issue date.
next: Review a sample of NO_MATCH and NOT_POSSIBLE cases.
decision: Whether a review queue or registry face check is worth its cost; any threshold change needs risk validation.
